I answered Pree in her #central-random thread: the ticket is **#8841**.

Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is a member of that channel, so she could already see the message.

He didn't name Marrow Fieldworks in that message. He was answering Hollis about "Tobias's dealer account" and the Plains depots. The account page lists Tobias as Marrow Fieldworks' owner since January 2026 and describes it as a Plains dealer network, so I'm confident that's the account.

I didn't find any status update on the ticket after that message, so I told her to check with Tobias before the call.
